Given the following question and four candidate answers (A, B, C and D), choose the best answer.
Question: A toy truck rolls over a smooth surface. If the surface is covered with sand, the truck will most likely roll
A. slower
B. faster
C. at the same speed
Respond with one of the four choices (A, B, C or D).
